name: Dawn Court
summary: A compact sculpted mosque sits beneath one centered dawn sun, bringing the prayer day into the identity.
why: The sun, dome peak and doorway all share the same centerline. A deliberate five-unit sky gap separates the sun from the dome. Twin minarets and the prayer hall meet one common foundation, while the attached gold face repeats the sun color.
risk: The sun adds an explicit morning association. The low, broad architecture is intentionally compact at small sizes.
sub2: A place for the daily prayers
reasonToChoose: You want a calm mosque with clear, connected architecture and a gentle sense of depth.
